meta.name: voice-of-customer
meta.description: Builds the loop from what customers say to what gets changed — collecting feedback, distinguishing signal from noise, routing it to owners, and closing the loop back to the customer. Use this to set up a feedback program, design or interpret CSAT/NPS, decide what customer feedback deserves action, get product to act on recurring issues, or diagnose why feedback is collected but nothing changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 建立从客户声音到产品变更的反馈闭环
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果产品团队收集了客户反馈却迟迟没有行动。
copy.tagline_en: Build a closed loop from customer voice to product change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team gathers feedback but struggles to act on it.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你建立“客户反馈→产品改动”的闭环：从工单、流失原因、访谈、调研等渠道收集意见，区分噪音、量化问题、指派负责人、定期评审，最后把改动结果告诉客户。
howto.when: 当你说想建立反馈机制、设计或解读 CSAT/NPS，或让产品处理反复出现的客户问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个客户反馈收集方案。
say.note: Claude 会列出渠道、量化口径和评审机制。

say.text: 这份 NPS 分数该怎样解读？
say.note: 它会提醒你结合自由文本和行为数据看趋势。

say.text: 客户反复说上传太慢，怎么让产品团队处理？
say.note: 它会指导你量化问题、指定负责人进入评审。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through a feedback loop: collect input from support, churn reasons, interviews, surveys; filter noise, quantify, assign owners, review, and report changes back to customers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up a feedback program, design or interpret CSAT/NPS, or get product to act on recurring customer issues.

say_en.text: Help me design a customer feedback collection plan.
say_en.note: It will list channels, quantification rules, and review steps.

say_en.text: How should I interpret this NPS score?
say_en.note: It will remind you to look at free text and behavioral data.

say_en.text: Customers keep saying uploads are slow; how can product fix it?
say_en.note: It will guide you to quantify and assign an owner.
